newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Mercosur millers move to form joint association.
newsitem.headline: Mercosur millers move to form joint association.

text.p: Wheat millers from South America's Mercosur customs union plan to create an association of their national groups, Argentina's Milling Industry Federation said Tuesday.

Millers from Mercosur members Argentina, Brazil, Uruguay and Paraguay met in Buenos Aires Monday to discuss the move, and named Argentine Marcos Lagomarsino to preside a provisional grouping of the four countries.
"The talks will continue with the final objective of founding an institution which gathers together those presently meeting and those of any countries which may join Mercosur," the Federation said.
Mercosur has a free-trade agreement with Chile and is negotiating another with the Andean Group, which groups Bolivia, Venezuela, Colombia, Peru and Ecuador.
